title: need 的用法

examples.en: He needs to get up early.

guess.question: “你不必担心”能说成 You don't need worry 吗？

options.text: 不行——need 作实义动词时要说 don't need to worry
options.feedback: 对！need 有两种身份：情态动词（needn't do，无 to）和实义动词（need to do，有 to）。

options.text: 可以，两种说法完全一样
options.feedback: 不对——need 前面有 don't 时，后面必须带 to。
不对——You needn't worry 是对的，You don't need to worry 也是对的。

rule.rule: need 作情态动词时：need do / needn't do（无 to、无 s，多用于否定和疑问）；作实义动词时：need to do / don't（doesn't）need to do
rule.formula: ① 情态动词：Need I come? — No, you needn't.（不加 to、不加 s）　② 实义动词：He needs to go. / He doesn't need to go.（有 to、有 s）

anchors.en: We need to buy some bread.

trap.wrong: He needs not to come tomorrow.
trap.right: He needn't come tomorrow. / He doesn't need to come tomorrow.
trap.why: 两种身份不能混用：要么 needn't do，要么 doesn't need to do。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——needn't 后面直接跟动词原形；don't need 后面必须带 to。

check.stem: You ____ worry about the exam. It's quite easy.

options.distractor: don't need 后面要加 to
need 不与 be 动词连用

check.stem: He ____ to wear a thick coat today. It's very warm.
check.explanation: doesn't need to wear（实义动词用法）。

options.text: You don't need to come tomorrow.

options.distractor: don't need 后面要加 to

check.explanation: don't need to come（实义动词）正确。
